agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py `_process_case`: changed `first = next(cond[1].flatten())` back to `first = next(cond[0].flatten())`. The initial (pre-WHEN) condition tuple returned by Case.get_cases() only ever contains a single token (leading whitespace), so indexing with `cond[1]` raised `IndexError: list index out of range`, breaking CASE expression formatting under `reindent=True` (with and without `compact=True`). Verified with manual reproduction scripts covering simple CASE WHEN, CASE <expr> WHEN, no-ELSE, multiple sibling CASEs, nested CASE, and CASE inside UPDATE SET, across reindent, compact, and reindent_aligned modes — all produce correct output with no exceptions. This is a minimal one-line fix restoring prior correct behavior; no other files were changed.
